xingtian-r2: Use case: stylized-concept. New revision concept art for Xing Tian, four original martial relics inspired by Shang and Zhou bronze in a dark fantasy pixel game. Same flat slate studio concept board with exactly four separated objects in one row, equal cells, no captions, no watermark, no character. Design all armor to look athletic and dangerous, long taper, proud rising angular lines and fitted construction. First a tall upright three-quarter warrior helmet with sharp swept cheeks, dark EMPTY face opening and very subtle bronze animal-mask crest, avoid a bowl or big round dome. Second a broad-shouldered but strongly tapered front-facing V-shaped cuirass with articulated plate facets, angular angry eyes cast into its upper chest and a narrow grim mouth lower down, avoid a pot belly. Third two slim articulated front greaves with pointed knee ridges, squared thunder patterns and narrow shin guards. Fourth two low-profile but tall-cuffed boots with a solid flat combat sole in side view pointing right, one boot lifted slightly so the sole shows a few radial engraved lines. Dull old bronze edges, rich dark iron in shadow, deep muted oxidized teal sparingly, no loud orange. Strong silhouette and a few bright edge glints, designed for exact 32px reduction.
